description: Search the Sapporo Open Data open data catalogue (CKAN) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "公園": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: Sapporo Open Data. License: Public Data License 1.0 (PDL 1.0, Government of Japan). Japanese-first catalogue — Japanese keywords return the most results (English can return none).

query.description: Search term for this source (see the tool description for what it expects).
